title: Towards Thinking-Optimal Scaling of Test-Time Compute for LLM Reasoning
authors_zh: Wenkai Yang、Shuming Ma、Yankai Lin、Furu Wei（机构：中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院、Microsoft Research）
paper_type_zh: 测试时计算分配与自改进研究（NeurIPS 2025）
best_for_zh: 研究推理长度控制、过度思考与按题分配推理预算的读者。
one_line: TOPS selects shortest correct effort-conditioned reasoning traces to train task-dependent test-time thinking length.
TOPS 从不同推理努力下的候选中选择最短正确回答，训练模型按题目选择合适的测试时思考长度。
why: It treats reasoning length as an allocation variable that can hurt accuracy when extended indiscriminately.
inclusion_reason: It studies the allocation of reasoning length at test time and trains a model to use task-dependent effort rather than monotonically longer chains.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Longer chains of thought are often treated as a universal way to spend more inference compute. The paper shows why that rule is unsafe: responses with more reasoning rounds can contain more erroneous intermediate steps, and training or deploying with an excessively long effort can reduce accuracy, especially on easier tasks. The useful decision is not whether to make every response longer, but how much reasoning effort a particular problem warrants.

The paper asks how a reasoning model can learn a task-dependent test-time length policy. Its central record is a problem paired with several responses generated under low, medium, and high effort, their length and correctness, and the selected shortest correct trace. This record changes a fixed-length distillation target into an allocation target: preserve enough computation for hard questions while not teaching the model to add redundant or error-prone reasoning to easy ones.

更长的思维链常被当作使用更多推理计算的通用办法。论文说明这一规则并不安全：具有更多推理轮次的回答会包含更多错误中间步骤，而以过长努力训练或部署可能降低准确率，尤其是在较简单的任务上。有用的决策不是让每个回答都更长，而是某个具体问题究竟需要多少推理努力。

论文研究推理模型如何学习依赖任务的测试时长度策略。其核心记录是一个问题配上在低、中、高努力下生成的多个回答、它们的长度与正确性，以及被选出的最短正确轨迹。该记录把固定长度的蒸馏目标改为分配目标：为困难问题保留足够计算，同时不教模型在简单问题上加入冗余或易错的推理。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
TOPS defines a thinking-optimal response as the shortest correct System-2-style response the model can produce for a problem. Shorter effort may leave the problem unsolved, while longer effort can introduce unnecessary rounds and mistakes. The goal is therefore a conditional policy over effort levels, not a global preference for concise or long traces.

The method first teaches a tag model to follow explicit low, medium, and high effort labels using a small seed set. It then generates answers for additional problems at each effort and keeps the shortest correct answer across those attempts. Fine-tuning the base model on this selected collection is intended to make the eventual model choose enough thought for difficult examples and stop earlier for easy ones. Correctness, effort label, response length, and selection rule are all essential to the construction.

TOPS 将“思考最优回答”定义为模型为一个问题能够生成的最短正确系统二式回答。更短的努力可能无法解出问题，更长的努力则可能带来不必要的轮次和错误。因此目标是关于努力等级的条件策略，而不是对简短或冗长轨迹的全局偏好。

方法先用小型种子集教会标记模型遵从明确的低、中、高努力标签；再针对额外问题在每种努力下生成回答，并从这些尝试中保留最短的正确答案。随后在这一选出集合上微调基础模型，意在让最终模型为困难例子投入足够思考、为简单例子更早停止。正确性、努力标签、回答长度和选择规则都是该构造不可缺少的部分。

title: Method
方法
html:
The first stage, format imitation, uses 1.3K NuminaMath seed problems and 3.9K QwQ-32B-Preview responses under three effort levels to train a tag model. In the second stage, that model generates one response at each effort for an additional 50K NuminaMath problems. For a problem with more than one correct answer, the construction retains the shortest correct response; combined with low-effort seed responses, this yields a reported thinking-optimal collection of about 26K samples.

The final stage performs supervised fine-tuning on this selected collection. The main system is based on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, with additional experiments on LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct. The paper evaluates GSM8K, MATH500, and AIME2024, reports mean accuracy over five random seeds, uses temperature 1.0 and a 16,384-token maximum generation length, and compares against QwQ-32B-Preview and same-base distillation models. The selection relies on knowing correctness during construction, whereas deployed generation only receives the learned effort behavior.

第一阶段“格式模仿”使用 1.3K 个 NuminaMath 种子问题，以及 QwQ-32B-Preview 在三种努力等级下生成的 3.9K 个回答来训练标记模型。第二阶段中，该模型对额外 50K 个 NuminaMath 问题分别在每种努力下生成一个回答；若一个问题有多个正确回答，构造保留其中最短者。再加入低努力种子回答，得到论文报告的约 26K 条思考最优集合。

最后阶段在该选择集合上进行监督微调。主系统基于 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，并在 LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct 上补充实验。论文在 GSM8K、MATH500 和 AIME2024 上评估，报告五个随机种子的平均准确率，使用 1.0 温度和 16,384 token 的最大生成长度，并与 QwQ-32B-Preview 及同底座蒸馏模型比较。构造时的选择依赖已知正确性，部署生成则只能使用学得的努力行为。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The analysis first shows that the best response-length regime depends on task difficulty. For Qwen2.5 tag models, the reported best accuracy moves from low effort on GSM8K (95.53%) to medium effort on MATH500 (91.48%) and high effort on AIME2024 (42.00%). The paper also measures the number and proportion of erroneous reasoning rounds and reports that both rise as effort increases, providing a concrete mechanism for why indiscriminate length expansion can be harmful.

In the end-to-end study, the authors state that Qwen2.5-32B-TOPS outperforms other reported distillation-based 32B o1-like models over the mathematical benchmarks and is comparable to its QwQ-32B-Preview teacher. They additionally compare random correct-response selection with selecting the shortest correct one, isolating the importance of the filtering rule. The evidence supports a task-dependent-length claim on the stated models and math data; it does not show that shortest-correct selection is available or optimal for arbitrary domains without a reliable correctness signal.

分析首先显示最佳回答长度制度依赖任务难度。对于 Qwen2.5 标记模型，报告的最佳准确率从 GSM8K 的低努力（95.53%），转为 MATH500 的中努力（91.48%）和 AIME2024 的高努力（42.00%）。论文还测量错误推理轮次的数量和比例，并报告二者都会随努力增加而上升，为不加区分地扩展长度为何有害提供了具体机制。

在端到端研究中，作者指出 Qwen2.5-32B-TOPS 在数学基准上超过其他报告的基于蒸馏的 32B 类 o1 模型，并可与其 QwQ-32B-Preview 教师相比。论文还比较随机选择正确回答与选择最短正确回答，从而隔离过滤规则的重要性。证据支持所述模型和数学数据上的依赖任务长度主张，却没有证明在没有可靠正确性信号的任意领域中，最短正确选择都可获得或最优。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Previous long-chain distillation typically consumes a fixed distribution of teacher responses and treats length as a generally beneficial feature. TOPS changes the record-selection decision: a problem is observed under several controlled effort labels, and the consumer is trained on the shortest response that passes the correctness contract. This makes response length a problem-conditioned allocation variable rather than a side effect of a teacher's default behavior.

The contribution is not merely pruning traces after they are generated. The selected traces teach a model to imitate distinct effort modes and then to internalize an effort-sensitive response policy through self-improvement. The closest excluded alternative would only impose a length cap at inference; this work changes what supervised examples are chosen and the behavior that is trained. Reuse requires checking whether correctness filtering and effort labels retain the same meaning in the target domain.

以往的长链蒸馏通常消费教师回答的固定长度分布，并把长度视为普遍有益的特征。TOPS 改变了记录选择决策：一个问题在多个受控制的努力标签下被观察，训练消费者只使用通过正确性契约的最短回答。这使回答长度成为依赖问题的分配变量，而不再只是教师默认行为的副产物。

贡献不只是生成后剪短轨迹。被选轨迹先教模型模仿不同努力模式，再通过自改进内化对努力敏感的回答策略；最接近但未纳入的替代方案只会在推理时施加长度上限，而本工作改变了监督例子的选择和被训练的行为。复用时必须检查正确性过滤与努力标签在目标领域是否仍具有相同含义。

title: Limitations
局限
html: TOPS needs a correctness signal to select the shortest correct trace, which is readily available for the reported mathematical construction but may be costly or ambiguous for open-ended tasks. It uses three discrete effort levels and one response per level in its stated main generation setup, so the learned policy may miss finer-grained budgets or useful rare alternatives. The paper's token-length analysis also does not replace measurement of real latency, memory, or tool-use cost; those costs must be assessed when transferring the method.
TOPS 需要正确性信号来选择最短正确轨迹；该信号在报告的数学构造中容易获得，但在开放式任务中可能昂贵或含糊。方法使用三个离散努力等级，且在所述主生成设置中每个等级只生成一个回答，因此学得策略可能遗漏更细粒度的预算或有价值的罕见替代方案。论文的 token 长度分析也不能替代真实延迟、内存或工具使用成本的测量，迁移方法时必须重新评估这些成本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a system has verifiable training problems and needs to avoid a one-size-fits-all reasoning budget. A replayable dataset should retain the problem, each effort label, all generated responses, length, correctness result, selected trace, base and teacher model versions, and the final fine-tuning split. At evaluation, plot accuracy and actual serving cost by task difficulty, not only a single average token length, because the claimed benefit is the allocation of effort across heterogeneous problems.
当系统拥有可验证训练问题且需要避免一刀切推理预算时，本工作可直接参考。可回放数据集应保留问题、每个努力标签、全部生成回答、长度、正确性结果、被选轨迹、基础模型与教师模型版本，以及最终微调切分。评估时应按任务难度绘制准确率和实际服务成本，而不能只报告单一平均 token 长度，因为论文声称的收益来自跨异质问题的努力分配。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: First inspect the selection contract: TOPS is strongest when correctness can be checked and the shortest correct answer is a sensible target. Then distinguish the training-time construction from deployment-time behavior; the model does not solve a new problem by looking at all correct alternatives, but by internalizing patterns from the selected collection. Finally compare against a fixed-length distillation baseline under matched base model, teacher, data volume, and actual latency, and examine the random-correct-response ablation to isolate the value of shortest-correct filtering.
先检查选择契约：当正确性可被检查且最短正确答案是合理目标时，TOPS 最有力量。随后区分训练时构造和部署时行为；模型并非通过查看一个新问题的所有正确替代方案来求解，而是从被选集合中内化模式。最后，应在匹配基础模型、教师、数据量和真实延迟下与固定长度蒸馏基线比较，并检查随机正确回答消融，以隔离最短正确过滤的价值。
